releases.name: Carrot Revenge
releases.summary:
You are RABBIT, a lonely survivor from an alien abduction, you don't know where you are, or why. After waking up, you realize you aren't home, and that escaping is not an option.

In this bullet-hell journey, encounter more than 10 types of enemies (and more than a hundred of them).

Explore different builds and mechanics and more importantly, survive!

releases.name: Desktop Tiny Tides
releases.summary: Turn your desktop into a living fishing world. Drag your boat across the screen, discover 144 different fish, cast your line wherever they swim, complete timing-based fishing, upgrade your equipment, and build your collection.

releases.name: Pomoroid
releases.summary: A Pomodoro timer & calendar app where a character you made cheers you on and even chats with you via AI whenever you need to focus. Freely customize everything from Pomodoro backgrounds to to-do management, alarms, and stickers, then share your cheer packs and alarm packs with others on the Workshop

releases.name: Paleo Dive
releases.summary: A calm VR diving adventure through prehistoric underwater worlds. Explore coral reefs, kelp forests and the deep sea, gather finds and upgrade your gear at your own pace. VR only (OpenXR).

releases.name: Motelet
releases.summary: Motelet is an incremental game about cleaning dusty rooms with a cute robot vacuum. Clear away dust and debris, earn coins, and purchase powerful upgrades as you transform your humble cleaner into the ultimate cleaning machine.

releases.name: Stellar End
releases.summary: "Your ship has just been repaired! Fight your way through numerous trails. This system really needs your help!" Cool combination of classic Sci-Fi 2D "Shoot 'em up" with 3D FPP on-rails shooter. Weaponry system is gradually getting quite complex, dogfights are quite addictive and challenging.

releases.name: Escape from Company
releases.summary: A puzzle escape game set in a company that won’t let you quit. Solve challenging puzzles, overcome absurd workplace rules, and escape with your resignation.

releases.name: Kitty Needs A Home!
releases.summary: A cozy idle game about a shelter for cats. Catch fluffballs in the yard, fulfill heartwarming requests from around the world, collect an album of happy endings — and win Jane's heart. Cuteness, pixels, and purring. Plays itself while you're away!

releases.name: Arxanum Idle
releases.summary: Immerse yourself in a medieval fantasy world inspired by many other great idle titles. Follow the story as a fallen deity and reclaim your lost power after being betrayed by your fellow Guardians.

releases.name: Football Legacy Manager 27
releases.summary: Build the ultimate legacy as the general manager of a professional American football team!

releases.name: VOXEL ISLE SIMULATOR
releases.summary: Raise an island from the sea, seed it with life, then smite it, flood it, or raise its dead. A voxel god game where tribes you never command learn masonry and gunpowder, forge kingdoms and go to war, and every power you use is written into a history you can click to visit.
